body.x: Business France, responsible for fostering export growth by French businesses, will showcase innovations from 200 French tech start-ups in two pavilions at the Consumer Electronic Show (CES) from 5th to 8th January 2023. French start-ups in the 'La French Tech' pavilions will introduce solutions to challenge the international tech ecosystem in Las Vegas.

Since 2014, Business France has been supporting French businesses at the CES, with the involvement from all of France's regions growing higher year after year. So far, around 900 French start-ups have exhibited at the CES.

In CES 2023, more than 200 companies selected by Business France will attend - 170 French start-ups at the Tech Pavilion, 16 French businesses in the autonomous & Smart vehicle sector at the Vehicle Pavilion, and 30 start-ups at the Learning Expedition. The Tech Pavilion is at Hall G booth #60200 of the Eureka Park in The Venetian Convention and Expo Center, and the Vehicle Pavilion is at West Hall booth #5400 in the Las Vegas Convention Center.

body.cap: Partners of La French Tech Pavilions (Image Source - Business France)

body.x: Start-ups in the Tech Pavilion specialize in different fields, like health, well-being, mobility, GreenTech, AI, robotics, SportTech, SmartHome, cybersecurity, and the Metaverse. They dedicate to developing a future world through innovative technologies that nurture life, enhance health, and revolutionize everyday lives.

The French companies exhibiting in the Vehicle Pavilion aim to improve safety and efficiency inside automobiles while retaining their user experience. They will propose solutions for Smart and autonomous vehicles.
Business France will hold three networking events - each with focused topics - and a special French Tech evening at the pavilion. The schedule is following:
January 5th, 2023 (Thu): Consumer Tech, HealthTech, and Industry 4.0

The French Tech evening will follow the 1st-day networking event. It will invite international audiences to discuss ecological transition, hosted by Clara Chappaz, Director of the French Tech Mission.
January 6th, 2023 (Fri): Artificial Intelligence, GreenTech, smart cities, mobility, and tourism
January 7th, 2023 (Sat): Connected Women and Web3 / Metaverse.
